name: Overall higher-education opportunity
measures: National breadth, participation, completion and credible quality signals in tertiary education.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | World Bank | national education ministries | OECD as a supplement
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS tertiary enrolment/graduation/ISCED indicators | World Bank EdStats | OECD Education at a Glance
downgrade_rationale: Quality is not captured by availability alone; rankings are commercially licensed and institution-weighted.

name: Technology and engineering education
measures: Strength and availability of tertiary programmes and graduates in engineering, ICT and related fields.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | national education/accreditation bodies | OECD | commercial ranking publishers
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS graduates/enrolment by ISCED field | national programme registers | subject rankings for discovery
downgrade_rationale: Global field-of-study counts are plausible, but comparable programme quality and institution location are not.

name: Medical and health-sciences education
measures: Availability and quality of medicine, dentistry, nursing, pharmacy and allied-health education.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | WHO | World Directory of Medical Schools | national accreditors
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS health-field graduates | WDOMS | national accredited programme registers
downgrade_rationale: Programme quality, recognition and seat access vary by profession and institution; WDOMS is not a quality ranking.

name: Business, commerce, and management education
measures: Availability and quality of business, finance, economics, accounting and management education.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | national accreditors | OECD | commercial ranking/accreditation bodies
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS business-field graduates | official programme registers | AACSB/EQUIS and subject rankings for discovery
downgrade_rationale: Accreditation and rankings cover a selective institution set and carry licensing and selection bias.

name: Research and innovation ecosystem
measures: National research intensity, outputs, patents, doctoral capacity and university–industry links.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | WIPO | World Bank | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS R&D expenditure/researchers | WIPO IP Statistics | doctoral graduates | Global Innovation Index components
downgrade_rationale: A composite must avoid mixing inputs and outputs or importing opaque GII weights.

name: International-student accessibility
measures: Practical accessibility for international students: enrolment openness, English-taught options, visas and support.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | OECD | national immigration and education authorities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS inbound student mobility | OECD international students | official student-visa and post-study rules
downgrade_rationale: Mobility stock is comparable; admissions, English-taught programmes and visa rules need manual current-policy coding.

name: Tuition affordability
measures: Tuition cost faced by representative domestic/international students relative to income or PPP.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | OECD | national ministries and institution fee schedules
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS education finance | OECD tertiary fees | official fee schedules | ICP PPP denominators
downgrade_rationale: Fees vary by institution, programme, residency and scholarship; global harmonised international-student prices are unlikely.

name: School education quality
measures: Primary/secondary learning outcomes, completion and system quality.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO UIS | World Bank | OECD | IEA
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UIS SDG4 completion/proficiency | World Bank Learning Poverty/HCI | PISA | TIMSS/PIRLS
downgrade_rationale: Administrative completion is broad, but common learning assessments miss many stable-universe countries and cycles.

name: International-school availability
measures: Availability and affordability of recognised international schools in likely destinations.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: IB | Cambridge International | national school registries | international-school directories
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: IB World Schools | Cambridge school finder | official school lists | fee schedules
downgrade_rationale: A city-level institution inventory and commercial-directory licensing would be required.

name: Recognition and portability of qualifications
measures: Ease of academic/professional recognition and portability of foreign qualifications.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO | ENIC-NARIC networks | national recognition and professional bodies
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Global/Regional Recognition Conventions | WHED | ENIC-NARIC country procedures | regulated-profession rules
downgrade_rationale: Outcome depends on origin, destination, qualification and profession; no single country score is defensible.

name: Overall job-market opportunity
measures: National employment opportunity using employment, unemployment, participation and labour-underutilisation signals.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | World Bank | national statistical offices
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT modelled estimates and harmonised labour-force indicators | World Bank WDI representations
downgrade_rationale: Vacancies are not globally comparable, so the first version should stay with harmonised labour outcomes.

name: Software and technology jobs
measures: Depth of software, ICT, data, AI and cybersecurity employment.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | national statistical offices | official vacancy services | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT employment by ISCO/industry | official vacancies | OECD ICT employment | online-job data for discovery
downgrade_rationale: Global occupation aggregates are broad; granular tech vacancies are platform-dependent and concentrated in cities.

name: Medical and healthcare jobs
measures: Demand and employment opportunity for health professionals, separate from licensing access.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | WHO | national health-workforce observatories
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT occupation/industry employment | WHO health workforce density | official shortage lists
downgrade_rationale: Provider shortage is not equivalent to accessible jobs, and licensing must remain a separate gate.

name: Business, finance, and professional-services jobs
measures: Demand for finance, consulting, accounting, marketing, operations, sales and management roles.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | national statistical offices | official vacancy services
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT ISCO/industry employment | labour force surveys | official vacancies
downgrade_rationale: Occupational groupings are broad and vacancy data are uneven; major-city concentration is material.

name: Engineering and skilled technical jobs
measures: Demand for civil, mechanical, electrical, industrial, energy and skilled technical roles.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | national statistical offices | official vacancy/shortage lists
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT ISCO/industry employment | labour force surveys | official shortage occupation lists
downgrade_rationale: Broad ISCO groups are comparable, but specialisms, licensing and regional projects are not.

name: Entrepreneurship and startup opportunity
measures: Business formation, firm entry, startup activity, finance access and survival conditions.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank | OECD | national business registries | Global Entrepreneurship Monitor
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: World Bank Entrepreneurship Database | Enterprise Surveys | GEM | venture databases for discovery
downgrade_rationale: Startup funding/activity sources often have selective coverage or commercial terms; formation counts are not survival quality.

name: Average earning potential
measures: Representative gross/net earnings, ideally occupation- and cost-adjusted.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | World Bank | OECD | national statistical offices
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT earnings | ILO modelled labour income | OECD average wages | ICP PPP conversion
downgrade_rationale: National averages mask occupation, tax and city-cost differences; net pay requires household scenarios.

name: Income growth and career mobility
measures: Wage growth, promotion prospects and occupational mobility over time.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | OECD | national longitudinal and labour-force surveys
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT wage growth | OECD earnings mobility | harmonised panel/microdata where available
downgrade_rationale: Promotion and mobility require longitudinal microdata that are not globally harmonised or broadly reusable.

name: Employment protection and worker rights
measures: Formal and effective protection on hours, leave, dismissal, bargaining and core labour rights.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | national labour ministries
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILO NATLEX/NORMLEX/EPLex | ILOSTAT working time | convention ratification | official statutes
downgrade_rationale: Law, ratification and enforcement are distinct; comparable coding requires current legal review.

name: Remote-work suitability
measures: Digital and legal practicality of remote work, including connectivity, visas, coworking and time-zone fit.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ITU | official immigration authorities | commercial coworking/latency providers
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ITU connectivity | digital-nomad visa rules | coworking directories | time-zone calculation
downgrade_rationale: It overlaps internet and visas, while time zone and legal fit depend on employer and user origin.

name: Personal income-tax burden
measures: Effective personal income-tax burden for representative income and household cases.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National tax authorities | OECD | IMF/World Bank for denominators
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official tax schedules/calculators | OECD Taxing Wages | PwC/KPMG summaries for discovery
downgrade_rationale: OECD's comparable effective-tax model covers only 38 countries; global extension requires maintained official-rule coding.

name: Social-security and mandatory contribution burden
measures: Employee/employer payroll, pension and other compulsory contribution burden.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National social-security/tax authorities | OECD | ILO
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official contribution schedules | OECD Taxing Wages | ILO Social Security Inquiry
downgrade_rationale: Global comparability is constrained by ceilings, benefit entitlements and the same OECD coverage limit.

name: Consumption and indirect-tax burden
measures: VAT/GST/sales-tax rates and household exposure to indirect taxation.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National tax authorities | IMF | OECD | World Bank
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official VAT/GST schedules | IMF tax databases | OECD Consumption Tax Trends | household expenditure weights
downgrade_rationale: Headline rates are broad but effective burden needs country-specific exemptions and household consumption baskets.

name: Overall affordability
measures: Relative household-consumption price level against a common benchmark.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank ICP
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ICP household-consumption PPP and price-level indexes
downgrade_rationale: Already represented in Konsider; retain as an existing monitor, not a new Phase 5 research target.

name: Housing affordability
measures: Rent/home-price burden relative to income and availability in likely migrant destinations.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National statistical offices | OECD | Eurostat | central banks | city housing observatories
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: OECD affordable housing | official rent/price indexes | housing-cost-overburden | city rent datasets
downgrade_rationale: High decision value justifies strategic research, but a national average is misleading and global city rent data are often commercial.

name: Healthcare affordability
measures: Out-of-pocket spending, insurance burden and financial-protection risk.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO | World Bank | national health accounts
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WHO GHO out-of-pocket share | catastrophic health spending | UHC financial protection | national insurance rules
downgrade_rationale: Aggregate out-of-pocket shares do not describe immigrant eligibility, premiums or point-of-care prices.

name: Childcare and family-cost burden
measures: Childcare fees and other recurring family costs for representative households.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: OECD | UNICEF | national ministries/statistical offices | city providers
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: OECD net childcare costs | UNICEF family policies | official childcare fee/coverage schedules
downgrade_rationale: Fees depend on age, city, income, subsidies and immigration status; OECD-style comparisons do not approach global coverage.

name: Savings and disposable-income potential
measures: Net income remaining after taxes and essential household costs.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved earnings, tax, housing, health and childcare components
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculator | no independent dataset
downgrade_rationale: This is a profile-derived composite with shared inputs and scenario weights, not an independent criterion.

name: Currency and macroeconomic stability
measures: Inflation, exchange-rate volatility and broad macro/sovereign stability.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: IMF | World Bank | BIS | national central banks
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: IMF WEO/IFS | World Bank WDI inflation/exchange rates | sovereign risk only as supplement
downgrade_rationale: A transparent small indicator set is preferable to a proprietary sovereign-risk composite.

name: Existing immigrant share
measures: International migrant or foreign-born stock as a share of resident population.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN DESA Population Division | World Bank representation | national censuses
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: International Migrant Stock 2024 total destination and population denominator
downgrade_rationale: The source mixes country-of-birth and citizenship definitions and many 2024 values are extrapolated.

name: Immigrant community depth
measures: Size, origin diversity and local concentration of established migrant communities.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN DESA | national censuses/statistical offices
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UN migrant stock by origin/destination | census foreign-born by origin | city population tables
downgrade_rationale: Origin-specific usefulness and city concentration make a single national diversity score weak.

name: Skilled-work visa accessibility
measures: Accessibility of skilled-worker routes under a fixed worker profile and policy date.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National immigration authorities | EU Immigration Portal | OECD/ILO as cross-checks
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official visa statutes, occupation lists, salary thresholds, quotas, processing guidance
downgrade_rationale: No global ready-made dataset; eligibility depends on occupation, salary, origin, sponsor and changing rules.

name: Permanent-residency accessibility
measures: Time, eligibility and predictability of permanent residence under defined scenarios.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National immigration authorities | EU Immigration Portal | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official residence statutes/guidance | long-term residence rules | policy coding
downgrade_rationale: PR eligibility is route-, origin- and family-dependent and needs maintained legal coding.

name: Citizenship accessibility
measures: Time and restrictions for naturalisation, including dual citizenship and tests.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National citizenship authorities | UNHCR/Global Citizenship Observatory | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official nationality laws | GLOBALCIT modes/law databases | dual-citizenship rules
downgrade_rationale: Formal law is codable, but discretion, residence counting and policy updates complicate a scalar score.

name: Post-study migration pathway
measures: Ability of international graduates to stay, work and transition after study.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National immigration authorities | OECD | UNESCO/OECD student-mobility systems
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official post-study work rules | OECD retention indicators | student-to-work transition rules
downgrade_rationale: Pathways depend on credential level, institution, occupation and policy date.

name: Family reunification support
measures: Ability to sponsor spouses, children, parents and other dependants.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National immigration authorities | EU Immigration Portal | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official family-reunification statutes, sponsor thresholds, waiting periods and dependant work rights
downgrade_rationale: Family definitions, income thresholds and sponsor status differ materially; parent sponsorship is especially non-comparable.

name: Government stance toward immigrants
measures: Formal immigration-policy direction, integration supports and stability of migrant access.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN DESA | OECD | national governments | MIPEX research consortium
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UN World Population Policies | OECD integration indicators | MIPEX | legal anti-discrimination components
downgrade_rationale: It conflates policy intent, rights, implementation and attitudes; leading indexes have limited coverage or licensing uncertainty.

name: Professional-licensing accessibility for immigrants
measures: Ease of foreign-qualification recognition and entry to a specified regulated profession.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National professional regulators | WHO | UNESCO/ENIC-NARIC | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official licensing rules | WHO health-worker regulation | recognition databases | profession-specific pathways
downgrade_rationale: Origin, profession, credential and language dependence prevent a universal score; deep research should test scenario templates.

name: Visa and immigration processing efficiency
measures: Transparency, speed and predictability of visa/immigration administration.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National immigration authorities | OECD | audit/ombudsman bodies
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official service standards and processing-time dashboards | refusal data | digitisation indicators
downgrade_rationale: Published clocks use different case types and exclude paused/incomplete cases; rejection rates reflect applicant mix.

name: English usability
measures: Extent to which work, education, health, government and daily life can be navigated in English.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: National census/statistical offices | UNESCO | EF for discovery
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Census language ability/use | official-language law | education language | EF EPI only as discovery
likely_freshness: SLOW_STRUCTURAL: census plus current legal status
downgrade_rationale: Commercial proficiency rankings are not enough; usability varies strongly by city and domain.

name: Local-language difficulty and learning burden
measures: User-specific burden of learning and needing the local language.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Official language sources | linguistic research | FSI-style difficulty evidence
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Official-language requirements | script/linguistic distance | training availability
downgrade_rationale: Difficulty depends on the user's known languages, profession and destination; no universal direction exists.

name: Social inclusion and acceptance of immigrants
measures: Surveyed acceptance of immigrants, discrimination experience and social trust.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Gallup | World Values Survey | regional barometers | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: World Poll migrant acceptance | WVS/EVS attitudes | OECD integration survey indicators | discrimination surveys
downgrade_rationale: Global surveys differ in years and samples, and small states are often absent; lived experience varies locally.

name: Cultural openness and diversity
measures: Religious, ethnic, cultural and lifestyle diversity and practical openness.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN agencies | WVS/regional surveys | national censuses | rights datasets
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Census diversity | religious freedom | attitude surveys | migration diversity components
downgrade_rationale: The construct mixes diversity, tolerance and freedom; direction and weights are contestable and city effects large.

name: Gender equality
measures: Legal and economic equality for women.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank Women, Business and the Law
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WBL 2026 legal, supportive-framework and enforcement-perception pillars
downgrade_rationale: Already represented in Konsider; monitor the verified WBL source rather than duplicate research.

name: LGBTQ+ legal and social inclusion
measures: Legal protection, recognition and safety for LGBTQ+ people.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN human-rights bodies | ILGA World | national legal authorities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILGA Laws on Us/Database | UN legal findings | official statutes
downgrade_rationale: ILGA has strong scope but its 2024 report is CC BY-NC; social acceptance/safety needs separate survey evidence.

name: Violent-crime and homicide safety
measures: Intentional-homicide risk, with broader violence only where genuinely comparable.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank WDI/UNODC | national justice systems
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WDI intentional homicide series | UNODC homicide data
downgrade_rationale: Homicide is already represented; reported violent crime should not be appended without comparability evidence.

name: Property-crime and everyday safety
measures: Day-to-day risk of theft, burglary, robbery, fraud and victimisation.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNODC | national police | harmonised victimisation surveys | city safety surveys
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UN-CTS recorded crime | victimisation surveys | police open data
downgrade_rationale: Recorded crime is dominated by reporting/legal differences; globally harmonised victim surveys and city coverage are sparse.

name: Political stability and civil peace
measures: Conflict, political violence, unrest and continuity of normal civic life.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank | UN | EU/JRC | UCDP/ACLED research sources
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WGI Political Stability | INFORM human hazard | UCDP conflict data | official travel/security alerts
downgrade_rationale: WGI is perception-based and conflict-event data may have licensing or reporting asymmetries.

name: Rule of law and institutional trust
measures: Rule of law, corruption control, judicial confidence and institutional performance.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank | UN | World Justice Project for discovery
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WGI Rule of Law/Control of Corruption/Government Effectiveness | UN SDG16 indicators
downgrade_rationale: WGI is a composite of perceptions with margins of error; institutional trust is not identical to rule of law.

name: Healthcare system capacity and quality
measures: Health-service capacity, coverage and quality using workforce, service and outcome indicators.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO | World Bank | IHME as research supplement
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WHO GHO/UHC service coverage, workforce and beds | avoidable mortality | World Bank indicators
downgrade_rationale: No single indicator captures access, quality and waiting time; mixed years and modelled values are likely.

name: Emergency-care readiness
measures: Ambulance access, trauma/emergency capacity and response readiness.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO | national emergency/health authorities | disaster agencies
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WHO emergency-care system assessments | ambulance/trauma registries | Joint External Evaluation components
downgrade_rationale: Global emergency-care assessments are sparse and national averages cannot represent response time.

name: Air pollution
measures: Population-weighted exposure to ambient PM2.5.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank/WHO | satellite-model consortia
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WDI PM2.5 mean annual exposure
downgrade_rationale: Already represented in Konsider; city exposure may be a later layer but not a duplicate national criterion.

name: Water quality and sanitation
measures: Safely managed drinking water/sanitation access and related service quality.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO/UNICEF JMP | World Bank | national utilities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: JMP safely managed drinking water, sanitation and hygiene | wastewater indicators
downgrade_rationale: JMP access is broad, but continuity, taste/contaminants and migrant-city reliability are separate constructs.

name: Food safety and public-health protection
measures: Strength of food regulation, inspection and outbreak prevention/response.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO | FAO | national food-safety authorities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WHO IHR capacities | Codex participation | foodborne disease estimates | official inspection systems
downgrade_rationale: Inputs and outbreak counts reflect surveillance capacity; comparable inspection-performance data are fragmented.

name: Mental-health support
measures: Availability, affordability and acceptability of mental-health services.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO | national health systems | IHME
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WHO Mental Health Atlas | provider density | service coverage | financial protection
downgrade_rationale: Provider counts do not measure affordability or stigma, and access is local with substantial missingness.

name: Electricity access and reliability
measures: Household electricity access plus outage frequency/duration and reliability.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank | IEA | national regulators/utilities | Enterprise Surveys
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: WDI electricity access | Enterprise Surveys outages | SAIDI/SAIFI | RISE policy indicators
downgrade_rationale: Access is near-global, but outage metrics lack harmonised 90% coverage; current experimental composite overlaps access.

name: Water-supply reliability
measures: Continuity, shortage risk and resilience of household/urban water supply.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: WHO/UNICEF JMP | national utilities | World Bank | WRI for stress
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: JMP availability-when-needed | utility continuity | water stress/drought indicators
downgrade_rationale: JMP access does not ensure 24/7 supply; utility-level continuity is not globally standardised.

name: Internet access, speed, and reliability
measures: Internet adoption, mobile/fixed coverage, performance, affordability and reliability.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ITU | World Bank | national telecom regulators | measurement firms for speed
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ITU DataHub/IDI components | WDI internet use | regulator QoS | Ookla/M-Lab for discovery
downgrade_rationale: ITU access/coverage is broad, but speed/outage measures may be commercial or incomplete; avoid duplicating the existing composite.

name: Transport and logistics infrastructure
measures: Road, rail, port, airport and trade-logistics performance.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank | UN transport agencies | national infrastructure ministries
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Logistics Performance Index | WDI transport | UN road/rail/aviation/port indicators
downgrade_rationale: LPI has limited country coverage and is perception-based; a broad composite would overlap existing infrastructure readiness.

name: Urban public transport
measures: Coverage, affordability, safety and reliability of public transport in destination cities.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN-Habitat | city transit agencies | GTFS publishers | OECD/ITF
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: SDG 11.2.1 | GTFS feeds | city route/stop/service data | fare schedules
downgrade_rationale: Country scores are invalid; a fixed city universe and reusable feed policy are prerequisites.

name: International connectivity
measures: Direct-flight access, airport connectivity and travel time to relevant origins/centres.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ICAO | IATA/OAG for discovery | airport authorities | OpenFlights for discovery
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ICAO air transport statistics | scheduled route data | airport connectivity indexes
downgrade_rationale: Route schedules are city/airport and origin-specific; comprehensive timetable data are usually commercial.

name: Digital-government readiness
measures: Availability and maturity of online services, digital ID and digital public administration.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN DESA | World Bank | ITU | OECD
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UN E-Government Development Index/Online Service Index | World Bank GovTech Maturity Index | ID4D
downgrade_rationale: Composite editions and weights require sensitivity review; user experience can diverge from formal availability.

name: Infrastructure readiness composite
measures: Combined digital and logistics readiness.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Existing Konsider inputs | World Bank/ITU
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Existing experimental infrastructure readiness composite
downgrade_rationale: Already available experimentally; Phase 5 should research its components rather than duplicate the composite.

name: Temperature comfort
measures: Climatological heat, cold, humidity and seasonal exposure at likely destinations.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Copernicus/ECMWF | World Bank CCKP | national meteorological agencies
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ERA5/ERA5-Land normals | CCKP ERA5/CRU aggregations | humidity/heat-index metrics
downgrade_rationale: Global data are excellent, but national averages are misleading and comfort has no universal direction.

name: Climate preference fit
measures: Match between a user's preferred warm/cold/dry/humid/four-season climate and destination conditions.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Copernicus/ECMWF | World Bank CCKP
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Derived preference model over ERA5/CCKP temperature, precipitation and humidity
downgrade_rationale: Data coverage is strong, but this belongs in a transparent preference model, not a higher-is-better criterion.

name: Extreme-weather risk
measures: Exposure to heatwaves, floods, storms, wildfire, drought and severe cold.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: EU/JRC INFORM | World Bank CCKP | WMO | UNDRR
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: INFORM hazard/exposure components | CCKP extreme indices | hazard-specific global datasets
downgrade_rationale: Hazard components have different scales and city exposure; avoid double counting vulnerability/coping capacity.

name: Long-term climate-change exposure
measures: Future physical exposure to sea-level rise, heat/water stress and ecosystem pressures.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: World Bank CCKP | IPCC/WCRP CMIP | NASA/ESA | WRI as supplement
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: CCKP CMIP6 scenarios | sea-level projections | water-stress and heat-exposure datasets
downgrade_rationale: Results depend on scenario, horizon, model ensemble and population exposure assumptions.

name: Natural-disaster risk
measures: Expected loss/exposure from geophysical and weather-related natural hazards.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: EU/JRC INFORM | UNDRR | World Bank | GEM/USGS
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: INFORM natural hazard/exposure | Global Assessment Report datasets | global earthquake/cyclone/flood layers
downgrade_rationale: Overlaps extreme-weather risk; geophysical hazards should be separable and composite weights tested.

name: Environmental quality beyond PM2.5
measures: Waste, water pollution, green space, noise, biodiversity and other environmental conditions.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNEP | Yale/Columbia EPI consortium | WHO | city agencies
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: SDG environment indicators | EPI components | city green-space/noise/waste data
downgrade_rationale: The construct is too broad, city-sensitive and dependent on composite weighting; EPI licensing must be checked.

name: Climate resilience and adaptation readiness
measures: Institutional and infrastructure capacity to adapt to and recover from climate shocks.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: EU/JRC INFORM | World Bank | UNDRR | ND-GAIN consortium
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: INFORM lack-of-coping-capacity | ND-GAIN readiness | adaptation policy indicators
downgrade_rationale: Readiness indexes are composite/modelled and overlap governance, infrastructure and disaster risk.

name: Work-life balance
measures: Working hours, paid leave, parental leave and commute burden.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | OECD | national labour authorities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILOSTAT actual hours | ILO NATLEX leave law | OECD work-life indicators | commute surveys
downgrade_rationale: Leave law is not take-up; commute is city-level and survey coverage is weak, so start with hours/leave components.

name: Family friendliness
measures: Family-support environment spanning leave, childcare, schools, safety and recreation.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | UNICEF | World Bank WBL | UNESCO | WHO
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Parental-leave law | childcare support | school/health/safety component criteria
downgrade_rationale: This is best as a transparent family profile assembled from approved components, not a new opaque dataset.

name: Quality of urban life
measures: Urban public space, walkability, cleanliness, congestion, amenities and design.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN-Habitat | city governments | satellite/open mapping providers
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: SDG 11 urban indicators | city prosperity | OpenStreetMap-derived amenities | congestion datasets
downgrade_rationale: Requires a city universe, geospatial methodology and multiple sources with uneven licensing.

name: Recreation, culture, and leisure
measures: Access to sports, arts, libraries, dining, nature and community activity.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UNESCO | city cultural agencies | open mapping | commercial POI providers
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Cultural participation statistics | protected-area access | POI/amenity inventories
downgrade_rationale: Amenity value is preference-based, highly local and usually reliant on commercial or volunteered POI data.

name: Religious freedom and freedom of expression
measures: Formal and practical religious freedom, expression and civic participation.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: UN human-rights mechanisms | OHCHR | national law | V-Dem/Freedom House for research
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: UN treaty/UPR evidence | official constitutional law | V-Dem freedom indicators | WGI Voice
downgrade_rationale: Legal guarantees and lived freedom diverge; prominent indices mix expert judgments and may have reuse restrictions.

name: Social protection and welfare support
measures: Eligibility and adequacy of unemployment, pension, disability and family benefits.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: ILO | World Bank | OECD | national social-security authorities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: ILO World Social Protection Database | NATLEX | ASPIRE | OECD SOCX
downgrade_rationale: Benefit access and value depend on contributions, residence, immigration status and household scenario.

name: Retirement suitability
measures: Combined suitability for older migrants: health, cost, pensions, residency, safety and lifestyle.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria | national retirement visa authorities
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile composite plus official retirement-residence rules
downgrade_rationale: Overlaps C84 and combines incompatible profile inputs; retain only one retirement profile after component approval.

name: Overall life satisfaction
measures: Average self-reported life evaluation of residents.
classification_tags: IC | SC | DO | CR | PF | LF
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Gallup | World Happiness Report | OECD as supplement
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Gallup World Poll Cantril Ladder | WHR 2026 three-year averages
downgrade_rationale: The measure is comparable but misses some small states, is an outcome rather than an actionable lever, and Gallup reuse terms need audit.

name: Suitability for a software professional
measures: Profile score for a software professional using jobs, pay, tax, English, visas and ecosystem.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculation only
downgrade_rationale: Explicit profile composite; no independent source search is warranted.

name: Suitability for a medical professional
measures: Profile score for a medical professional using demand, licensing, language, pay and visas.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculation only
downgrade_rationale: Explicit profession/profile composite; research its components instead.

name: Suitability for a student
measures: Student profile score using education, tuition, access, safety and post-study routes.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculation only
downgrade_rationale: Explicit profile composite; no independent criterion dataset exists.

name: Suitability for a family with school-age children
measures: Family-with-children profile score using schools, safety, health, housing and migration rules.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculation only
downgrade_rationale: Explicit household profile; component evidence and weights must remain visible.

name: Suitability for an entrepreneur
measures: Entrepreneur profile score using formation, finance, tax, immigration, markets and digital government.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculation only
downgrade_rationale: Explicit profile composite; research component criteria rather than seek a single index.

name: Suitability for retirement
measures: Retiree profile score using health, affordability, climate, residency, safety and life quality.
likely_authoritative_publisher_families: Derived from approved component criteria
likely_dataset_or_indicator_families: Profile calculation only
downgrade_rationale: Explicit preference/profile composite and duplicate of C77's intended decision.
